exceptions.reason: the system clock adapter is the one place that reads the real time

whys.because: it is the adapter that turns the platform clock into the Clock port

whys.why: Why must some file read the platform clock?
whys.because: basket ages are measured against real elapsed time in production

whys.why: Why not read the clock where the age is measured?
whys.because: domain code takes a Clock so tests can pin the time

whys.why: Why does one adapter satisfy CD-17?
whys.because: CD-17 confines time reads to the clock boundary, and this file is that boundary

whys.why: Why record it rather than leave the finding?
whys.because: an unrecorded finding fails the check, and the boundary is intentional

whyChain.rootCause: the platform clock has to be read somewhere, and the adapter is the designated place
